description:
A screenshot of the CLC+ (Copernicus Land Cover) Core Data Catalogue web application, accessible at `https://clcplus-core.land.copernicus.eu/datacatalogue`. The interface displays a table of land cover/land use (LULC) datasets with columns for "Name", "Type", "Created By", "Country", "Time Range", and "Status". Navigation options in the header include "Data Catalogue", "EAGLE Ontology", "About EAGLE", "Organisations", and "Users". Filter and action buttons above the table allow users to "Fil...", "My organisati...", "My d...", "Ingesti...", and "Extracti...". A search bar is present, along with "ADD INGEST..." and "ADD EXTRACT..." buttons.

The table lists several "CLC+_Instance_LULUCF" entries. Visible dataset entries include:
- "CLC+_Instance_LULUCF_2021_NI" (Netherlands/Nederland, 01.12.2018 - 31.12.2018, EXTRACTED)
- "Test Instances Issue with metadata" (Germany/Deutschland, 01.08.2023 - 31.08.2023, EXTRACTED)
- "LULUCF_beta_1.1._backtesting" (Netherlands/Nederland, 02.01.2017 - 01.01.2020, EXTRACTED_PREVIEW)
- "CLC+_Instance_LULUCF_2020_02" (European Environment Agency, 03.01.2017 - 02.01.2020, EXTRACTED_PREVIEW)
- "CLC+_Instance_LULUCF_2020_CZ" (Czech Republic/Česko, 02.01.2017 - 01.01.2020, DRAFT)
- "CLC+_Instances_alphaV..." (User Amelie, Ireland/Éire, 01.01.2017 - 31.12.2019, EXTRACTED_PREVIEW)
- "CLC+_Instance_LULUCF_2018_IE" (Ireland/Éire, 01.01.2017 - 31.12.2019, EXTRACTED)
- "CLC+_Instance_LULUCF_2018_alpha_1..." (Spain/España, 02.01.2023 - 13.01.2023, PUBLISHED)
- "workshop_example_extraction_GRA" (Denmark/Danmark, 01.01.2018 - 31.12.2018, EXTRACTED_PREVIEW)
- "workshop_example_extraction_urban" (Denmark/Danmark, 01.01.2018 - 31.12.2018, EXTRACTED_PREVIEW)

A context menu is open for the "CLC+_Instance_LULUCF_2020_CZ" entry, offering the options: "Open", "Open in new tab", "Download Dataset (GeoTIFF)", "Download Metadata (JSON)", "Reuse", and "Delete". The system clock in the bottom right shows "20:55" and "16.12.2023".
